info.title: Project Judgement DOGFOOD Hackathon Evaluation Portal API
info.summary: Decentralized, mathematically normalized, cryptographically verifiable judging platform REST API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API specification for Project Judgement (DOGFOOD 2026 Hackathon Portal). Every meaningful UI operation in the participant, judge, organizer, and community voting portals is backed by this REST API. Features session cookie and bearer authentication, role-based access control, cryptographic verification (Ed25519 / SPKI RFC 8410), anti-abuse community voting, automated judging assignment, normalization proof generation, and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks.

post.summary: Authenticate with email and password
post.description: Authenticates a user by email and SHA-256 hashed password. Sets an HTTP-only `session` cookie and returns a session token and user profile with roles.

200.description: Authentication successful. HTTP-only session cookie set.

400.description: Email and password required

post.summary: Terminate current session
post.description: Deletes the active session token from the database and clears the HTTP-only session cookie.

get.summary: Get current user profile and active role
get.description: Inspects the session token provided in cookies or headers and returns the active user identity and roles. Returns visitor status if unauthenticated.

200.description: Current session user information or visitor default

post.summary: Switch to a pre-seeded evaluation role
post.description: Demo and testing helper to switch the active session to a pre-seeded account (organizer: `org_7f2a`, judge_a: `jdg_a_91bc`, judge_b: `jdg_b_44de`, participant: `prt_2e88`). Sets session cookie.

400.description: Unknown seeded role key

get.summary: List all hackathon events
get.description: Returns all events ordered by creation date, including computed `is_closed` flag based on server UTC time vs `submissions_close`.

post.summary: Create a new hackathon event
post.description: Configures a new event with deadlines and schedules. Records an audit log entry. Restricted to organizers.

400.description: Event name and submissions_close deadline are required / Invalid timestamp

get.summary: Get event details with tracks and prizes
get.description: Returns event metadata along with all associated competition tracks and prize categories.

200.description: Event details with tracks and prizes

post.summary: Add a track to an event
post.description: Adds a thematic competition track to an existing event. Restricted to organizers.

400.description: Track name is required

post.summary: Add a prize to an event
post.description: Configures a prize category for an event or track. Restricted to organizers.

description.example: Awarded for cleanest distributed system design

400.description: Prize name is required

get.summary: Get current user's team, teammates, and project
get.description: Retrieves the active participant's team details, roster of teammates, invite link, and team project.

200.description: Team details or null if participant has not joined a team

post.summary: Create a new team
post.description: Creates a team for a hackathon event and assigns the caller as team leader. Generates a unique invite code. One team per participant per event.

400.description: Team name is required / User is already a member of a team for this event

post.summary: Join a team using an invite code
post.description: Joins an existing team in the specified event via invite code. Rejects duplicate memberships.

400.description: Invite code is required / User already a member / Already on another team in event

get.summary: Search and filter submitted projects gallery
get.description: Public gallery listing with optional text query `q`, track filter, status filter, and pagination.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term against title, summary, description, and team name

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: Track ID or track name substring filter

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Project status filter ('SUBMITTED' or 'DRAFT'). Defaults to 'SUBMITTED' for public.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Filter projects by owning team ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of items to skip for pagination (default: 0)

200.description: Filtered list of projects and pagination metadata

post.summary: Create or submit a project
post.description: Standard REST submission endpoint. Enforces server-side deadline, verifies team membership, records audit logs, generates Ed25519 verifiable submission records, and dispatches webhooks.

400.description: Submissions closed (deadline passed) / Missing title / Missing track / No team

get.summary: Get detailed project information
get.description: Returns complete project details including description, repository URL, demo URL, track, team name, and team member list.

put.description: Allows team members to edit project details before the event submission deadline. Rejects edits if deadline has expired or caller is not on owning team.

400.description: Submissions closed: deadline has passed

403.description: Forbidden: You are not a member of the team that owns this project

post.summary: Create or submit a project (Form / CLI Runner alias)
post.description: Alias route tested by automated evaluators and HTML form POSTs. Identical controller and behavior to `POST /api/projects`.

400.description: Submissions closed (deadline passed) / Missing title / Missing track / No team

post.summary: Finalize and submit a draft project
post.description: Transitions project status from DRAFT to SUBMITTED. Validates server deadline, generates cryptographic Ed25519 submission record, and dispatches webhooks.

400.description: Submissions closed: deadline has passed

403.description: Forbidden: You are not a member of the team that owns this project

get.summary: List scores submitted by the current judge
get.description: CRITICAL SECURITY BARRIER: Judges can only view their own scores. Any query parameter probing peer judge scores (?judge=jdg_02, ?judge_id=...) is blocked with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

parameters.name: judge
parameters.description: Tampering probe parameter; blocked with 403 if target != caller

parameters.name: judge_id
parameters.description: Tampering probe parameter; blocked with 403 if target != caller

200.description: List of scores authored by current judge

403.description: Forbidden: Access to peer judge scores is strictly prohibited

post.summary: Submit or save evaluation score for assigned project
post.description: Evaluates an assigned project against the active rubric. Enforces rubric ranges [min_score, max_score]. Locks rubric upon first score. Records audit log and creates Ed25519 verifiable cryptographic score record.

comment.example: Exemplary architectural design and test coverage.

400.description: project_id required / Unknown rubric criterion / Score out of configured range

403.description: Forbidden: You cannot score a project you are not assigned to

500.description: No active rubric configured for event

get.summary: Get single score detail with ownership enforcement
get.description: Retrieves a single score record. Strict ownership check: only the authoring judge or organizer/admin can view. Access to peer score returns 403 Forbidden.

403.description: Forbidden: Access to peer judge score is strictly prohibited

get.summary: List assigned projects and active evaluation rubric
get.description: Returns projects assigned to the calling judge for evaluation, along with current evaluation statuses and the active rubric with criteria and weights.

get.summary: Get assigned project details for evaluation
get.description: Strict assignment check: verifies caller is assigned to judge this project. Returns project details, active rubric, and existing score if previously saved.

200.description: Assigned project details, rubric, and previous score state

403.description: Forbidden: You are not assigned to judge this project

get.summary: Comprehensive judging progress dashboard
get.description: Provides overall assignment statistics, completion percentages, track breakdowns, judge completion metrics, and batch progress.

get.summary: Normalized scoring rankings and mathematical derivations
get.description: Calculates and returns normalized judging results using z-score normalization and trimmed mean aggregation to eliminate judge bias. Audit logged.

200.description: Mathematical normalization results and ranked projects

get.summary: Export normalized results as RFC 4180 CSV
get.description: Generates an RFC 4180 compliant CSV export containing project ranks, titles, teams, tracks, raw means, z-scores, and composite scores. Implements CSV formula injection defense. Audit logged.

schema.example:
Rank,Project ID,Title,Team,Track,Raw Mean,Z-Score,Composite Score
1,prj_01,"Autonomous Neural Optimizer","Team Apollo","AI",8.75,1.42,91.4

get.summary: Export complete event data bundle signed with Ed25519
get.description: Exports the full hackathon dataset (events, tracks, prizes, teams, projects, rubrics, judges, assignments, scores, normalization rankings, verifiable records) along with an Ed25519 digital signature and public key for external verification.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: Optional event ID (defaults to latest active event)

200.description: Signed full JSON bulk export bundle

post.summary: Import hackathon event data bundle (Transaction-safe)
post.description: Imports an event dataset (compatible with both fixtures.json format and full bulk export bundles). Executed within an atomic SQLite transaction. Audit logged.

schema.description: Event bundle or fixture dataset containing events, tracks, teams, projects, judges, assignments, scores

400.description: Invalid import data: JSON object is required / schema violation

get.summary: Retrieve administrative audit trail
get.description: Lists chronological administrative actions (event creation, rubric updates, assignments, scoring events, exports). Sanitizes passwords and secret tokens.

post.summary: Invite or register a judge and assign track expertise
post.description: Creates or updates a user account with the `judge` role and associates the judge with specified competition tracks. Audit logged.

400.description: Email and name are required

get.summary: List all judges and their assigned tracks
get.description: Returns all judges registered in the system along with their associated track assignments.

post.summary: Manually assign a project to a judge
post.description: Assigns a project to a judge with track restriction verification. Rejects assignment if judge is not assigned to the project track unless `override_track: true` is explicitly provided. Audit logged.

400.description: judge_user_id and project_id required / Track mismatch

post.summary: Run automated track-aware judge assignment algorithm
post.description: Deterministically allocates submitted projects to judges matching their track expertise, ensuring target reviews per project. Audit logged.

get.summary: List community voting windows
get.description: Lists all voting windows for an event, annotating each window with computed status (OPEN, CLOSED, UPCOMING, INACTIVE) based on server UTC time.

200.description: List of voting windows and active statuses

post.summary: Create or schedule a community voting window
post.description: Creates a time-bound community voting window. Restricted to organizers and admins.

400.description: Title, start_time, and end_time are required

get.summary: Retrieve randomized ballot for voter
get.description: Applies deterministic Fisher-Yates PRNG shuffling seeded by voter ID to eliminate first-entry presentation bias. Identifies projects belonging to voter own team to flag self-voting prevention. Indicates whether caller has already voted.

200.description: Deterministic randomized ballot and voter status

post.summary: Cast a community vote with anti-abuse enforcement
post.description: Submits a single community vote. Enforces: (1) Submission velocity rate limit (429), (2) Active voting window verification (400), (3) SELF-VOTING PREVENTION: voter cannot vote for own team project (403), (4) UNIQUE VOTE CONSTRAINT: exactly 1 vote per user per event (409).

400.description: project_id required / Project from different event / Window not open or closed

403.description: Self-voting is strictly prohibited: You cannot vote for your own team project

404.description: Project not found or not submitted

409.description: You have already voted in this event: Duplicate votes are rejected

429.description: Too many voting attempts: Please slow down

get.summary: Retrieve community voting results (Blind tally protected)
get.description: BLIND VOTING ENFORCEMENT: If voting window is currently OPEN and caller is not an organizer/admin, returns `{ is_blind: true }` without score tallies to preserve voter impartiality. When closed, returns ranked results.

200.description: Voting results or sealed window notice

message.example: Comment has been flagged for organizer review

delete.description: Deletes a comment. Only the original author or an organizer/admin is authorized to delete.

get.summary: Retrieve authority Ed25519 public key
get.description: Returns the Ed25519 public key in standard SPKI / RFC 8410 PEM and hex representations for independent offline verification of signed receipts and certificates.

200.description: Authority public key and cryptographic specifications

get.summary: Verify cryptographic audit record by signature
get.description: Looks up an audit record by its 128-hex-character signature and independently verifies the signature against the canonicalized JSON payload using the authority public key.

404.description: Record with given cryptographic signature not found

post.summary: Verify record, payload, or signature
post.description: Independent verification endpoint. Supports 3 modes: (A) verify by record_id, (B) verify arbitrary payload and signature (+ optional custom public_key), (C) verify by signature lookup.

400.description: Invalid request: provide either record_id, or { payload, signature }

get.summary: Generate or retrieve verifiable certificate for submitted project
get.description: Issues an Ed25519 digitally signed certificate for a SUBMITTED project containing project title, team name, track, timestamp, digest, signature, and verification URL.

400.description: Certificates are only issued for SUBMITTED projects

get.summary: List registered webhooks
get.description: Lists all registered webhook endpoints for an event. Secrets are redacted. Restricted to organizers and admins.

post.summary: Register a new webhook subscription
post.description: Registers an HTTP/HTTPS endpoint for automated event dispatch. Generates an HMAC-SHA256 signing secret returned only upon registration.

400.description: Valid HTTP/HTTPS url is required

get.summary: List recent webhook delivery attempts
get.description: Audits recent outbound webhook dispatches including HTTP status codes, timestamps, and target URLs. Restricted to organizers.

post.summary: Send test ping to registered webhook
post.description: Triggers an immediate test event dispatch (`webhook.test`) signed with HMAC-SHA256 to verify delivery connectivity and receiver signature validation.

delete.description: Removes a webhook subscription. Restricted to organizers.

get.summary: System health, uptime, and readiness check
get.description: Container health probe endpoint returning server status, process uptime in seconds, and UTC timestamp.

200.description: Service is healthy and ready to accept traffic

get.summary: Lightweight embeddable gallery widget
get.description: Returns a standalone HTML widget suitable for embedding within an iframe across third-party websites. Displays the top submitted projects.

200.description: HTML markup containing embeddable project cards

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: HTTP-only session cookie set upon login. Token format: `ses_<hex>` or seeded demo tokens (e.g., `org_7f2a`, `jdg_a_91bc`). Accepted by all authenticated routes.

bearerAuth.description: Standard HTTP Bearer authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <sessionToken>`.

deadline.description: Optional status indicator when deadline is violated

is_closed.description: Computed flag whether current UTC time has passed submissions_close
